subject: TotalEnergies Club EV-Charge public authentication blocker

public_review_signals: multiple current public reviews report inability to receive the verification code or log in

interpretation.finding: Native app verification is currently operationally constrained by a publicly corroborated authentication/login blocker; failure to validate live station/status/tariff data through an interactive app session should not be interpreted as absence of the underlying Numocity data surface.
interpretation.numocity_request_shape_impact: The existing static evidence for GET-oriented status routes remains relevant. Investigation should continue through sanitized static client analysis and anonymous read-only public request shapes only; do not bypass authentication or use account-bound traffic.
